scope: Whole-turn windowing for the GLiNER contextual stage (fixes silent truncation fail-open hole); straddling spans counted, not dropped; report exposes window count + dropped-span count

step0.premise: GLiNER medium-v2.1 truncates input beyond ~384 tokens so tail clues are never analysed
step0.evidence: red.log (46-turn session: tail clues undetected before fix) + gliner_config.json max_len=384, truncation=True in gliner/model.py encode

red.result: 2 failed / 1 passed: tail combination and isolated tail clue undetected (truncation); benign long session fine

commands: full suite chunks: fast 60 / integration 21 / e2e+negative 39, all exit 0

gate_impact.18_fixture_decision_table: green.log — all 18 UNCHANGED, 0 more-permissive changes (raw: before-18fixtures.log / after-18fixtures.log)

design.rationale: 384-token model limit; ~4 chars/token English; conservative margin incl. labels
design.whole_turns: never split inside a turn; over-long turns split at word boundaries with 30-word overlap
design.straddling_spans: counted in report.context_dropped_spans, never silently dropped

limitations: windows are sequential, not batch_predict_entities (deprecated API); one extract call per window — CPU cost scales with window count (~2 extra calls on a 46-turn session)
token estimate is character-based (conservative); a pathological all-CJK turn could under-estimate tokens per char — future work could tokenize exactly
